# Chicas Map

Free San Antonio map of verified garage, yard, and estate sales. Near Me, multi-stop routes, and weekend intel.

## Key pages
- [Live map](https://www.chicasmap.com/map/): Interactive pins and routes
- [This weekend’s sales](https://www.chicasmap.com/list/): Curated list
- [List a sale free](https://www.chicasmap.com/submit/): Add your sale
- [Sale Intel](https://www.chicasmap.com/intel/): Pin-level notes
- [Alamo Atlas](https://www.chicasmap.com/atlas/): Civic safety layer

## Notes
Content is updated daily. Always verify times and addresses with the original source.
